confidence_notes: Food estimates draw on Arugam Bay meal-price aggregates, Sri Lanka-wide cost data, and a few local menu prices. July accommodation is a broad seasonal estimate; cocktail and wine prices vary by venue and are less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: No city proxy for food prices: Arugam Bay estimates are used with Sri Lanka-wide restaurant costs as a baseline. Accommodation reflects a small, seasonal Sri Lankan surf town.
